Contract ManageBankCardCRUDService::deleteBankCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		card: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		card.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		BankCard.allInstance()->excludes(card) and
		result = true or
		card.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false
}
